content.title: KBR secures NASA contract worth up to $3.6 billion for astronaut health support
content.summary: Engineering contractor KBR said on Wednesday it had secured a $2.46 billion contract from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration to support astronaut and worker health and safety during space missions. Shares of KBR rose 2.7% in extended trading. The five-year agreement, starting November 1, includes two optional extensions potentially extending the contract until 2035.
